guard: split trust-record failures use one accurate non-material diagnostic and never echo hostile stored bytes
why: The SecretStore wrapper deliberately hides low-level JWT/parser detail, but its old fallback
claimed every composition failure meant the operator did not sign the account. A malformed JWT
is corruption, not that specific binding failure. The unit plants a literal JWT canary and
requires one accurate generic cause while also proving the stored bytes remain absent.

mutations.name: the wrapper returns to the inaccurate operator-signing-only diagnosis
mutations.find: `the trust records (${BROKER_AUTH_KEY} + ${accountKey}) failed trust-chain validation for space "${space}" - the store values are corrupt, mismatched, or outside one broker/account trust chain; repair or replace them`,
mutations.replace: `the trust records (${BROKER_AUTH_KEY} + ${accountKey}) failed trust-chain validation for space "${space}" - the store holds an account this broker's operator did not sign; repair or replace it`,
mutations.expectRed: a malformed split account JWT reports an accurate generic trust failure without echoing stored bytes
mutations.cell: a malformed split account JWT reports an accurate generic trust failure without echoing stored bytes

mutations.name: the generic wrapper echoes the hostile stored account JWT
mutations.find: `the trust records (${BROKER_AUTH_KEY} + ${accountKey}) failed trust-chain validation for space "${space}" - the store values are corrupt, mismatched, or outside one broker/account trust chain; repair or replace them`,
mutations.replace: `the trust records (${BROKER_AUTH_KEY} + ${accountKey}) failed trust-chain validation for space "${space}" - the store values are corrupt, mismatched, or outside one broker/account trust chain; repair or replace them; stored account JWT=${account.account.jwt}` ,
mutations.expectRed: a malformed split account JWT reports an accurate generic trust failure without echoing stored bytes
mutations.cell: a malformed split account JWT reports an accurate generic trust failure without echoing stored bytes
